findings.message: UnwiredClearService has clear() but its service is never reset between requests (missing kernel.reset tag).
findings.remediation: Tag the service so services_resetter calls it after each request: ->tag('kernel.reset', ['method' => 'clear', 'on_invalid' => 'ignore']). on_invalid: ignore keeps the container valid when a decorator replaces the service, since the resetter calls the outermost one.
